motions.description: Approve all items on the Consent Agenda including minutes, bills and vouchers, license applications, and various resolutions and ordinances.
Ratify President Saviano's approval of a raffle application submitted by Rich Mazzulla Sr, Italian American War Veterans Post #10, for a Queen of Hearts raffle to be held at Circle Tavern.
Approve a raffle application submitted by John Machonga, American Veterans Community Trust, to sell raffle tickets during the 2026 Taste of Elmwood Park.
Approve a raffle application submitted by John Machonga, American Veterans Community Trust, to sell raffle tickets during their annual Veterans Dinner on November 10, 2026 at Donny G's.
Approve President Saviano's re-appointments to the West Suburban Special Recreation Association, with Ted Gruber as Regular Representative and Alan Schmidt as Alternate Representative.
